notes: HD 271791: The paper calls it a “likely unbound star” (T:p4-b3) and its abstract and conclusions describe it as an unbound runaway (T:p1-b14, T:p21-b6), supporting the retained candidate classification. Section 3 notes that the minimum allowed rest-frame velocity of 530 km s−1 would be only marginally bound (T:p15-b2, T:p15-b3), but the paper retains the unbound label in its final assessment. US 708 is mentioned only as a proposed runaway (T:p4-b3), without an explicit Galactic-unbound assessment; HVS1 appears only in background discussion (T:p4-b2); neither is included as an individually studied eligible star.

HD 271791: T:p15-b3 states HD 271791 is marginally bound for a rest-frame velocity of 530 km/s, but no numerical bound/unbound probability is reported. The 12–16 kpc Galactocentric values in T:p4-b3 and T:p15-b0 are inferred birth/origin radii, so they are not recorded as present-day galactocentric radii. T:p16-b1 uses r≈20 kpc in a joint-probability estimate, while T:p15-b3 gives r≈21 kpc from Heber et al.; both are reported. The rest-frame velocity range 530–920 km/s (T:p15-b0) encompasses the ∼900 km/s upper limit mentioned in T:p15-b1 and T:p15-b4.
